baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated accusatives at 80:31 place فاكهة and أبّ on one syntactic level while preserving their different use profiles.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pleasant fruit and pasture-fodder form a compact provision spectrum: one foregrounds produce enjoyed as fruit, while the other keeps animal nourishment and ground herbage inside the same account of abundance.

activation_trace.role: Fruit as pleasant produce supplies the humanly recognizable edible pole of the coordinated pair.
Pasture and fodder herbage supplies the grazing and livestock pole without demoting it from provision.

changed_reading.before: Two loosely adjacent botanical items in an inventory.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately paired ecology of provision spanning fruit enjoyed by people and herbage sustaining grazing life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root fields of both focus nouns remain available beneath their ordinary food senses: ف ك ه carries delighted enjoyment, and ء ب ب carries intention, readiness, and homeward inclination.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair can organize appetite spatially and affectively. One provision attracts through pleasure; the other evokes a creature becoming ready and oriented toward what sustains it, so food is also a system of attachment and directed movement.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant ease and delighted enjoyment make the fruit an affective attractor rather than a neutral commodity.
Intent and readiness give the second noun a latent vector toward need satisfaction.
Yearning toward homeland extends that vector into attachment to a sustaining place.

changed_reading.after: Provision as an attractor and orientation system: delight draws, while need and remembered habitat direct movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Form-distant branches within the two focus roots converge on nourishment and readiness before a process is complete.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rich milk appearing before birth and an appointed, prepared time create a threshold model: the pair can be heard as nourishment arriving through ripening, thickening, and readiness, not merely as finished objects lying in a list.

activation_trace.role: Rich early milk before birthing supplies nourishment becoming available at a generative threshold.
An appointed prepared time supplies the temporal threshold at which provision becomes usable.
Readiness reinforces process and imminence rather than static inventory.

changed_reading.before: Finished produce named after growth has ended.
changed_reading.after: Produce at the moment of prepared maturity, with nourishment understood as the outcome of timed becoming.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rare focus noun أبّ is anchored both in pasture and in branches of animal readiness, stirring, and movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fruit suggests a harvestable destination, whereas pasture can make animals range, ready themselves for water, and stir across land. The pair therefore permits a dynamic ecology of fixed yield and mobile foraging.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant produce supplies the comparatively place-bound harvest destination.
Antelope readying for water makes the fodder landscape behaviorally active.
Moving or stirring supplies motion as a latent property of the pasture term.

changed_reading.before: Fruit and fodder as stationary stocks.
changed_reading.after: A landscape of harvest points and moving grazers whose needs organize routes through provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to inspect food, followed by poured water, opened soil, and emergence from fertile earth, converts the focus pair from terminal labels into the visible outputs of a causal water-soil-growth chain.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant fruit is one inspectable end product of the chain.
Pasture is the second end product, extending the chain beyond direct human eating.
Directing sight or insight supplies the investigative frame under which the pair is to be read.
Food as livelihood and good condition makes the inspected object a sustaining system rather than taste alone.
Pouring and downflow supply the first explicit material transfer in the chain.
Delivering water by irrigation specifies the medium that enables growth.
Cracking open supplies the transition from sealed ground to emergent life.
Soft fertile earth supplies the productive substrate.
Vegetation emerging from earth closes the causal path into the two focus outputs.

structural_cues: 80:24 opens an inspection of food, and 80:25-31 then advances in material sequence from water and soil to named yields.
The repeated verbal nouns for pouring and splitting make process unusually prominent before the noun pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inspection, food, water transfer, soil opening, emergence, and then the focus nouns; I supply the causal arrow that treats 80:31 as compressed outputs of that sequence. A live alternative is that the passage offers a rhetorical list without modeling production stages.

changed_reading.before: Fruit and pasture as isolated gifts.
changed_reading.after: Fruit and pasture as inspectable end states that retain the hidden labor of water, soil opening, and growth within them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus purpose clause assigns the whole abundance to people and livestock. It strengthens a two-audience reading while preventing a rigid one-item-per-audience partition: fruit and pasture have differentiated affordances inside one shared field of benefit.

activation_trace.role: Delighted enjoyment supplies the pleasure-rich mode of benefit.
Pasture and fodder supply the livestock-facing mode of benefit.
Benefit that is both enjoyed and useful joins delectation and utility under one purpose.
Livestock wealth identifies nonhuman consumers as explicit beneficiaries.

structural_cues: 80:32 follows the focus pair immediately and addresses both لكم and لأنعامكم.
The coordination in 80:31 and the dual beneficiary phrase in 80:32 favor inclusion over a narrow human menu.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pleasure, fodder, useful enjoyment, and livestock beneficiaries; I infer differentiated affordances rather than an exclusive lexical assignment of فاكهة to people and أبّ to animals. The live alternative is that every listed item serves both audiences without any internal weighting.

changed_reading.before: A human food list with fodder appended at its margin.
changed_reading.after: A shared provision field whose forms answer different creaturely tastes and needs without ranking one beneficiary out of view.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human death, burial, and revival precede an agricultural sequence in which closed earth opens and vegetation emerges. A branch that explicitly pictures rain reviving dry pasture makes the rare أبّ a material bridge: the focus pair becomes edible evidence of return from dormancy.

activation_trace.role: Nourishment appearing before birth makes fruit capable of carrying a life-at-threshold image.
Pasture is the exact vegetal domain that the revival branch later reanimates.
Stillness and dormancy supply a state that can describe both death and latent plant life.
Burial supplies enclosure beneath the surface before re-emergence.
Reviving the dead supplies the human-scale return that the food sequence materially echoes.
Rain reviving dry pasture directly joins resurrection imagery to the focus noun أبّ.
Earth opening supplies the release from burial-like closure.
The plant coming out of earth supplies the visible return that becomes fruit and pasture.

structural_cues: 80:21-22 gives death, burial, and revival immediately before 80:24 redirects the human toward food.
The later earth-opening and plant-emergence sequence repeats enclosure followed by release at another scale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dormancy, burial, revival, revived pasture, opened earth, and emerging vegetation; I infer that the agricultural process functions as a small-scale material analogy for resurrection. The live alternative is a looser juxtaposition of two divine acts rather than a shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Crops as evidence of present provision only.
changed_reading.after: Fruit and pasture as edible resurrection: dormant or buried potential is opened, revived, and made sustaining.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening scene contrasts attention given to one who presents as self-sufficient with attention withheld from one moving purposefully toward benefit. Against that contrast, pleasurable fruit and less prestigious fodder become an ethical test of appetite: visible desirability must not erase sustaining need.

activation_trace.role: Delighted enjoyment supplies the attractive pole that can monopolize attention.
Ordinary fodder supplies a necessary but less glamorous pole of provision.
Facial contraction supplies the first visible sign of selective reception.
Turning away supplies the directional withdrawal of attention.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion that appearance had obscured.
Self-sufficiency supplies the socially attractive but need-poor addressee.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end resonates with the focus root's readiness and orientation.
Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies the mechanism of appetite-driven misallocation.

structural_cues: The opening contrast is organized around whom one faces, who approaches, and who is neglected.
The focus pair similarly juxtaposes an immediately desirable food with provision whose value becomes clearest from another creature's need.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selective attention, self-sufficiency, purposeful approach, benefit, distraction, pleasure, and fodder; I infer a shared evaluative pattern in which attraction can crowd out need. The live alternative is that the interpersonal correction and the botanical list remain independent demonstrations rather than one ethical mechanism.

changed_reading.after: A correction of appetite and attention: provision must be recognized by the need it serves, not only by the pleasure or status it displays.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's delighted-enjoyment branch sits between an opening facial contraction and closing faces that expand in laughter and brighten with good news. Fruit remains literal, but it becomes an affective hinge: provision is registered on the face as well as consumed by the body.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant ease and delight place affect inside the semantic field of the fruit noun.
Literal pasture grounds the affective activation in material provision rather than replacing the food sense.
A face contracted by distress or anger supplies the closed affective surface at the opening.
The face as the forward surface supplies the site where the final state becomes visible.
Facial expansion and exposed teeth reverse the opening contraction.
News that opens the skin with joy supplies delight becoming outwardly legible.

structural_cues: The surah begins with a facial verb and ends by contrasting two classes of faces.
The focus noun lies in the intervening provision sequence but carries an independently supplied delight branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facial closure, fruit-associated delight, pasture, faces, laughter, and joy-opening news; I infer an affective arc in which material provision and visible response resonate. The live alternative is that the final facial states are eschatological signs with no causal dependence on the food sequence.

changed_reading.before: Fruit contributes only flavor and nutrition to the list.
changed_reading.after: Fruit also marks provision's affective register, mediating between a closed face and faces opened by joy while pasture keeps the reading materially grounded.

context_deltas.mechanism: Agrarian branches of ك ف ر picture seed and fruit under coverings, while the sequence gives seed, split earth, and emergence. This activates the focus pair as disclosure: fruit and pasture are what concealed potential looks like after its cover is breached and growth becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: Fruit as pleasant produce supplies the revealed mature output.
Pasture supplies a broad surface manifestation of previously latent growth.
Covering a blessing supplies the moral risk of failing to see provision as provision.
Covering seed supplies the physical concealment from which growth begins.
The seed that germinates and bears grain supplies latent form inside the covering.
Opening by rupture supplies the release mechanism.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the transition from hidden capacity to visible provision.

structural_cues: The moral root ك ف ر appears before the command to inspect food, and its inventory contains both blessing-covering and seed-covering branches.
The material sequence then moves from covered seed and earth to rupture, emergence, and mature yields.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies moral concealment, agricultural seed-covering, seed, rupture, emergence, and the focus yields; I infer that the physical process exposes the mechanics beneath the moral image. The live alternative is that the agricultural branch is only lexical background and does not organize this occurrence of ك ف ر.

changed_reading.before: Fruit and pasture as obvious surfaces of abundance.
changed_reading.after: Fruit and pasture as disclosures of covered potential, making the failure to recognize provision structurally analogous to keeping a blessing under cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence moves through vine fruit, cut green herbage, palms, and enclosed thick growth. The focus pair can therefore recategorize species and forms into two ecological-use strata: harvestable pleasant produce and a lower grazing layer within a dense cultivated habitat.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant produce supplies the fruiting and harvestable stratum.
Pasture and herbage supply the grazing and ground-cover stratum.
Grape as vine fruit gives a concrete member of the pleasant-produce class.
Cut moist herbage gives a concrete precursor to the pasture-fodder class.
The palm supplies a tall fruit-bearing layer.
An enclosed garden supplies the spatial container for multiple plant layers.
Thick, tightly interwoven growth supplies density and vertical complexity.

structural_cues: 80:28-30 moves from particular crops to the enclosing garden before 80:31 names broader output classes.
The focus conjunction can function as a capstone summary rather than merely adding two more species.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vine fruit, moist cut herbage, palms, enclosure, thickness, and the two focus classes; I infer canopy and grazing strata and treat the focus pair as ecological recategorization. The live alternative is a flat list with no intended vertical or classificatory architecture.

changed_reading.before: Two final entries appended to a sequence of crops.
changed_reading.after: A capstone that reorganizes the garden by output and feeding layer: fruit above or harvested, pasture below or grazed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measure, completion, appointed marking, and extension to a limit activate the focus branches of pre-birth nourishment and prepared time. The pair can be read as provision arriving through staged maturation whose usability depends on measure and timing.

activation_trace.role: Milk thickening before birth supplies nourishment that matures ahead of a threshold.
A prepared appointed time supplies the threshold at which latent provision is ready.
A measure by which a thing reaches its limit supplies bounded development.
Completion and coming to an end supply the distinction between underway and fulfilled.
A sign and appointed time reinforces readiness as scheduled rather than accidental.
Extension and rising until a limit supplies maturation toward usable fullness.

structural_cues: The human-creation sequence includes measurement, and the focus follows an agricultural sequence with ordered transitions.
The purpose clause after the focus turns maturity into actual use rather than decorative completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, completion, appointment, extension to a limit, pre-birth nourishment, and prepared time; I infer one maturation mechanism across them. The live alternative is that the rare focus branches remain unrelated lexical curiosities and the crops simply denote mature products.

changed_reading.before: Provision as an instantaneous finished gift.
changed_reading.after: Provision as timed fulfillment: nourishment thickens, reaches measure, and becomes available at a prepared threshold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form ordinarily names literal fruit, yet its packet inventory also carries convivial joking and feeding on reputations, while the opening supplies facial rejection, turning away, and distraction. It remains anchored as a semantic undertone of فاكهة, not a replacement translation; downstream prose should qualify it as an ethical echo about how enjoyment can become consumption of people.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier attaches to the ف ك ه root at focus word 1 and retains literal fruit alongside its social-speech branches.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant joking talk gives fruit a convivial social afterimage.
Feeding on reputations turns social enjoyment into a predatory form of consumption.
Facial contraction supplies the interpersonal injury against which social pleasure is tested.
Turning away supplies social exclusion as an enacted withdrawal.
Distraction by one thing from another explains how pleasant engagement can displace a vulnerable person.

changed_reading.after: Literal fruit with a social shadow: pleasure can nourish fellowship or turn people and reputations into objects of consumption.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it joins reproductive-fluid and pre-birth-milk branches to irrigation and plant emergence. It remains anchored in the focus branch of nourishment before birth and the packet's water, opening, and growth sequence; downstream prose should present earth-as-gestational-body only as a material analogy, never as the lexical meaning of 80:31 or an explicit personification.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The model attaches to the ف ك ه branch of rich milk before birthing and the ء ب ب branch of prepared timing at the two focus words.

activation_trace.role: Pre-birth milk makes the focus noun carry nourishment prepared before delivery.
Prepared appointed time supplies gestational timing and readiness.
Clear generative fluid from drop to semen supplies the reproductive side of the analogy.
Male fluid in the womb allows the poured water to activate a gestational register.
Opening after enclosure supplies a birth-like release.
Human growth and upbringing bridges biological development back into plant emergence.

changed_reading.before: The earth mechanically produces crops after irrigation.
changed_reading.after: The sequence can be imagined as gestation and delivery: fluid enters, enclosure opens, and already-prepared nourishment emerges as fruit and pasture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it lets the homeland-yearning branch of the rare أبّ resonate with later mother, father, and flight, and the near sound of أبّ and أب heightens the pull. It remains valid only as a directional and sonic activation anchored in distinct packet roots; downstream prose must explicitly avoid deriving ء ب ب from ء ب و or treating fodder as 'father.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun أبّ supplies both readiness and yearning toward homeland, while فاكهة supplies the pleasure associated with an inhabitable sustaining place.

activation_trace.role: Delighted ease supplies the attractiveness of settled provision.
Yearning toward homeland gives the focus pair an ordinary homeward vector.
Intent and readiness make that vector active rather than merely nostalgic.
Flight reverses movement from approach toward sustaining relations into escape from them.
Mother as origin, gathering point, and return supplies the center from which flight occurs.
Fatherhood and upbringing supply a distinct kinship root whose proximity creates, but does not etymologically justify, the sonic activation.

changed_reading.before: Provision fixes creatures comfortably within a sustaining habitat.
changed_reading.after: The focus briefly establishes a homeward economy of pleasure and pasture that the later flight from origins and kin catastrophically reverses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a laughter branch names the splitting of date spathe and fruit, allowing soil opening, fruit, and facial opening to share one image. It remains anchored through literal fruit at 80:31 and exact packet branches for splitting and laughter; downstream prose should call it a cross-domain opening motif, not claim that ضاحكة in 80:39 lexically denotes dates.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Literal fruit at focus word 1 is the middle term between earth opening and the botanical as well as facial branches of laughter.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant fruit supplies the concrete botanical middle term.
Earth cracking open begins the repeated opening mechanism.
Splitting of the date spathe and unripe fruit turns laughter itself into a botanical opening image.
Facial expansion and visible teeth carry the same opening pattern onto the human surface.
Good news opening the skin with joy completes the movement from soil to fruit to face.

changed_reading.before: Earth splitting, fruit, and laughing faces belong to unrelated domains.
changed_reading.after: Fruit becomes the hinge in an opening motif: soil parts, a fruiting sheath parts, and the face opens into visible joy.

strongest_changes: The focus pair changed from a flat produce list into the visible output of a water-soil-growth supply chain.
The pasture branch of أبّ made agricultural revival a material analogue of burial and resurrection rather than a generic nature image.
The post-focus beneficiaries changed the pair into shared but differentiated provision for people and livestock.
The opening attention failure and closing facial states activated ethical and affective readings of pleasure without displacing literal fruit and fodder.
summary.what_was_special: Two short nouns sustained several coexisting mechanisms: audience allocation, causal production, ecological strata and movement, timed maturation, concealment and disclosure, edible resurrection, and an affective-social test of enjoyment. The rare ء ب ب inventory was especially catalytic because pasture, readiness, homeland pull, movement, and prepared time could each revise the otherwise familiar fruit reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The human-versus-livestock weighting is strong, but the syntax may distribute the whole plant list jointly to both audiences rather than partition it.
The resurrection mechanism has an unusually direct revived-pasture bridge, yet the degree of intended analogy between human revival and plant growth remains uncertain.
The maturation, gestational, homeland, and social-consumption readings are branch-distant and should remain parallel exploratory activations, not lexical substitutions.
The garden-strata model depends on an inferred spatial ecology; the packet also permits a flat cumulative catalogue.
